name: Netherlands
notes: Depth: seed; national first pass in progress, not saturated. R001–R002 (2026-10-22 to 2026-10-23): 48 supporters and 75 evidence rows across named legislators, parties, NGOs, a regional union branch, experts and public open-letter signatories. All verified=n for maintainer review. Box 3 stock-tax proposals are explicitly limited to partial wealth; income and realised-gains reforms alone excluded. Map: 342 European-Netherlands municipalities and 12 provinces, official CBS 2026 codes and CBS/PDOK shapes under CC BY 4.0. Caribbean public bodies outside register/map. Five-city official-site search pilot did not confirm local support; wider subnational coverage pending. No private petition signers. R002 added 13 actors and 33 evidence rows to the pre-existing seed; older R001 evidence is retained and has not all been rechecked. See area_profile.md and research ledgers for scope, QA and next priorities.
